description: Show how clients in productions have added and removed identity providers over time. Note this shows the updates, not the initial requested on the create event. It also shows historic changes for clients in production at the time of query, e.g. if they altered many times in dev before going to production.

spec.rawSql:
WITH production_requests AS (
  SELECT
    r.id AS request_id,
    r.project_name
  FROM requests r
  WHERE 'prod' = ANY(r.environments)
  and r.project_name not ilike '%tian''s testing%'
  and r.project_name not ilike '%TestMarcoOm%'
  and r.project_name not ilike '%tian''s testing%'
),

normalized_changes AS (
  SELECT
    e.id AS event_id,
    e.request_id,
    pr.project_name,
    e.created_at,
    e.idir_userid,

    -- Case required, as change can be an array rearrangement (A), or a full field edit/delete (D/E)
    CASE
      WHEN change->>'kind' = 'A'
       AND change->'item'->>'kind' IN ('D', 'E')
        THEN change->'item'->>'lhs'
      WHEN change->>'kind' IN ('D', 'E')
        THEN change->>'lhs'
    END AS old_idp,

    CASE
      WHEN change->>'kind' = 'A'
       AND change->'item'->>'kind' IN ('N', 'E')
        THEN change->'item'->>'rhs'
      WHEN change->>'kind' IN ('N', 'E')
        THEN change->>'rhs'
    END AS new_idp

  FROM production_requests pr
  JOIN events e
    ON e.request_id = pr.request_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    COALESCE(e.details->'changes', '[]'::jsonb)
  ) AS change
  WHERE e.event_code = 'request-update-success'
    AND change->'path'->>0 = 'devIdps'
),

event_changes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    event_id,
    request_id,
    project_name,
    created_at,
    idir_userid
  FROM normalized_changes
),

idp_changes AS (
  SELECT
    ec.event_id,
    ec.request_id,
    ec.project_name,
    ec.created_at,
    ec.idir_userid,

-- Need to except old idps, as array rearrangements can lead to "old_idp" just being moved in the array. e.g:
--     old_idp      new_idp
-- ------------ -----------
-- azureidir    idir
-- githubbcgov  azureidir
-- NULL         githubbcgov
-- needs to show that only idir was added 
    ARRAY(
      SELECT nc.new_idp
      FROM normalized_changes nc
      WHERE nc.event_id = ec.event_id
        AND nc.new_idp IS NOT NULL

      EXCEPT

      SELECT nc.old_idp
      FROM normalized_changes nc
      WHERE nc.event_id = ec.event_id
        AND nc.old_idp IS NOT NULL
    ) AS added_idps,

    ARRAY(
      SELECT nc.old_idp
      FROM normalized_changes nc
      WHERE nc.event_id = ec.event_id
        AND nc.old_idp IS NOT NULL

      EXCEPT

      SELECT nc.new_idp
      FROM normalized_changes nc
      WHERE nc.event_id = ec.event_id
        AND nc.new_idp IS NOT NULL
    ) AS removed_idps

  FROM event_changes ec
)

SELECT
  created_at "Timestamp",
  project_name as "Project Name",
  NULLIF(array_to_string(added_idps, ', '), '') AS "Added Identity Providers",
  NULLIF(array_to_string(removed_idps, ', '), '') AS "Removed Identity Providers"
FROM idp_changes
WHERE (cardinality(added_idps) > 0
   OR cardinality(removed_idps) > 0)
   AND $__timeFilter(created_at) 
ORDER BY created_at DESC, request_id;
